research_attempts.query_text: NARA OSS index pages 101-102; complete Army exact-name comparison; CIA and Library of Congress checks; exact-name OSS, employer, occupation, obituary, institutional, directory and archival searches.
research_attempts.rejection_reasons: The sole newspaper candidate was a postwar Richard Curry OCR result, not Richard Currier; no record-specific candidate supplied an OSS or Box 160 bridge.
research_attempts.research_notes: Army-file absence is not negative proof.

research_attempts.query_text: NARA OSS index pages 101-102; complete Army exact-name and exact-private-identifier comparison; CIA and Library of Congress checks; OSS, employer, occupation, obituary, institutional, directory and archival searches.
research_attempts.rejection_reasons: Two newspaper candidates had incompatible surname or middle initial; four additional exact-name Army rows lacked the indexed private identifier. Occupation value 999 is uninterpreted.
research_attempts.research_notes: The exact private identifier confirms identity but supplies no employer or OSS chronology.
